proposal.blind_spot: When long_scoreboard and barrier stalls are low (as in the 0.027x and 1.0x failures, where under 40% of stall cycles are explained), the optimizer cannot see whether warps wait on shared-memory latency or on fixed-latency ALU dependency chains, so it misdiagnoses the low issue rate as a global-memory problem.

rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_short_scoreboar: HIGH -> rework shared memory: pad/swizzle against bank conflicts, replace cross-warp shared-memory reduction stages with warp shuffles or register partials / LOW -> shared memory is innocent, leave the layout alone and target global-load latency or coalescing instead
rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_wait_per_warp_a: HIGH -> break serial dependency chains: multiple independent accumulators per thread, unroll and interleave independent ops to create ILP / LOW -> ILP is not the limiter, do not add per-thread work that would just cost registers and occupancy
